Priya (CS): Aurora Health (pilot) asked for an urgent config: temp rate lift for sa-east-1 for their patient triage demo. Ask: 1,800 req/min, add 189.12.77.0/24 to allowlist, and prefer sa-east-1 routing. Auto-revoke after 5 days. They said launch is blocked otherwise and renewal looks shaky.

Felipe (Networking): Need confirmation of CIDR (got 189.12.77.0/24) and exact start time. Any TLS/GSLB changes?

Priya (CS): Start window requested 2026-04-08T10:00Z for 5 days. No new certs, standard API keys. They want a 12h notice before rollback.

Gabe (Account): If this gets approved, I'll set a daily spend alert and flag renewal outreach. Put a hard daily cap at $650 for safety.

Nina (Onboarding): I'll run the demo and need a scoped API key tied to the temp profile + a short howto for fallback to eu-south-1 if latency degrades.

ops-oncall: 1.8k rpm is reasonable for redwood-llama-s-13b for short durations but depends on concurrency/seq. Recommend enabling prefix caching and set concurrency_limit:12 for the profile.

Felipe (Networking): Plan: create rate_profile aurora-temp {region: sa-east-1, max_rpm:1800, expiry:2026-04-13T10:00Z, auto_revoke:true, concurrency_limit:12}, add 189.12.77.0/24 to allowlist, stage in canary, then promote. I'll open ticket.

infra-bot: Ticket #CS-4988 created: "Aurora Health - sa-east-1 temp lift + allowlist" assigned to Felipe.

Priya (CS): Thanks. Please ping here when ACL is live and when the scoped key is created. I'll update churn tracker: "Aurora Health - blocked launch; temp lift pending; renew risk mitigated if live this week."
